status: Audio assets frozen; Engineering integration, registry and audition-page generation pending
owner: Audio assets; Engineering runtime and combined delivery

events.current_loop: Start once on active bowl entry, one looping voice, fade in/out over 0.25s; stop at chute/log checkpoint.
events.flush_onset: One-shot at full-flush phase transition, never per frame or per current-strength update.
events.flush_surge: One-shot on chute entry/final pull; do not restart continuously or loop.
events.debris_impact: Debris landing or player impact; one shared effect voice, throttle at least 0.12s.
events.debris_break: Successful soft obstruction destruction once, prioritize over impact in same frame.
events.radio_chirp: Once per radio transmission/exchange, not each character or text line; minimum 0.5s cooldown.

lifecycle: Suggested four fixed voices: current bed, flush accent, debris, radio. New onset/surge may replace previous flush accent. Pause all; honor SFX mute; stop and clear on death/retry/title/scene exit/disposal. No muted-event backlog.
radio_mix: During radio overlay duck current and flush accent an additional 8dB, restore over 0.2s. Chirp before transmission text/voice; no voice recording supplied. Keep impact/weapon cues bounded. Device mix remains unreviewed.
loop_import: current-loop.wav only: enable forward loop across full 128000 frames. Other WAVs must not loop. Circular overlap already baked in; no restart gaps.
candidate_registration: Six initial candidates named by event; Engineering allocates new permanent slot IDs and next suffixes, preserves these exact source assets, registers candidates, refreshes runtime mappings, rebuilds audio/drain-damage-sound-auditions.html and runs --check. Audio does not edit shared registry/helper.
validation: All six WAVs decode with ffmpeg; Python syntax and 120-column/trailing-whitespace checks pass. Exact hashes/levels/seam measurements in manifest. No playback or subjective approval.
preservation: Keep all six original WAVs and this recipe; future revisions use new versioned paths. Existing death flush remains unchanged.
limitations: Numerical loop boundary check does not establish perceived seamlessness. Runtime, lifecycle tests, mixing, build and roadmap remain Engineering work.
